issues.problem: Static /etc/hosts pin of api.z.ai to 98.98.124.194 is stale-prone and undated. API endpoints frequently rotate IPs (and 98.98.x.x is an unusual range for an API host, suggesting possible direct/CDN edge routing that can change without notice). Fact itself acknowledges the risk but has no 'last verified' date — recommend re-verifying the IP resolves and TLS/SNI still works before relying on it.
